chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazal, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Zurara, who said:
I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: 'The Prophet of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) provided the grandmother with one-sixth as a provision.'

key_terms.طُعْمَةً: As a provision/grant (specifically in the context of inheritance distribution)

ai.seo_question: What is the share of the grandmother in Islamic inheritance according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi records the Prophet Muhammad granting the grandmother one-sixth of the estate as a specific provision (ṭuʿmah), establishing a foundational precedent in Shia inheritance jurisprudence. It underscores the principle that the grandmother’s share is derived from the Sunnah and the Prophet’s direct instruction, distinguishing it from the Quranic shares of primary heirs. This ruling is central to the Shia legal discourse on whether the grandmother inherits alongside the mother or if her share is exclusive under certain conditions.
